definitions.dip_spike: observed / median of the 8 full-resolution neighbours < 0.2 (dip) or > 5 (spike)
definitions.valid: finite solver DEM, six observations, both model DEMs and reconstructions
definitions.metrics: DEM MSE and MAE over valid pixels x 18 bins against the solver; EM error = sum |EM_pred - EM_solver| / sum EM_solver; AIA pooled over six channels
definitions.regions: distance from (2048, 2048) on the 4096 grid: disk < 1500, limb to 1700, off-limb beyond

clamp.definition: observed <= MIN_OBS = 0.001 DN/s in that channel

low_observation_log_ratio_hist.definition: pixels with observed < 1 DN/s: log10(max(recon, 0.5) / max(observed, 0.5)), bin edges below
